configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: Ninja generator with the MSVC toolchain (AGENTS.md §1). Configure must run inside a Visual Studio developer environment so cl.exe is on PATH (e.g. VS 2022 Developer PowerShell).

configurePresets.name: msvc-bench
configurePresets.description: Optimized build for the time-class gates: a benchmark reports product cost, and a Debug build inflates the write chain by 20-30x (ruling 7.35). tools/check/check_perf_gates.ps1 reads this build directory by default.

configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.description: The POSIX leg of SPEC.NF.PLAT.01: same Ninja generator and Debug build type, host toolchain taken from PATH (c++). No developer-environment wrapper is needed here, unlike the msvc preset.

configurePresets.name: linux-bench
configurePresets.description: Optimized POSIX build for the time-class gates, same contract as msvc-bench (ruling 7.35): a Debug reading inflates the write chain, so a benchmark must declare its build config.

configurePresets.name: linux-gui
configurePresets.description: POSIX desktop build with both X11 and Wayland window backends enabled so Borealis shows a real window on a Linux desktop. At runtime Aurora picks native Wayland when WAYLAND_DISPLAY is set, falls back to X11 (incl. XWayland), then HEADLESS if no display is available. HEADLESS stays ON as the headless-test fallback. Requires libX11 + Wayland libs (apt: libx11-dev libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev) and the vcpkg toolchain (SSH leg needs libssh, same as the 'linux' preset). The default 'linux' preset remains HEADLESS for headless test/bench runs.
